title: Kickin Croatian Tofu Stew
description: A fermented, creamy, and comforting Croatian dish featuring Thai green curry paste, perfect for a chilly evening. This flexitarian-friendly stew is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the vegetable broth over medium heat.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides.
Remove the tofu from the pot and set aside.
Add the Thai green curry paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked tofu back into the pot and stir to combine.
Using a syringe, drop small amounts of the sodium alginate mixture into the stew, creating spheres.
Let the stew simmer for an additional 5 minutes to allow the spheres to set.
